summary: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held June 23, 2026, where all director nominees, auditor KPMG, and the share compensation plan were approved. Concurrently, new director Sandeep Singh purchased 150,000 common shares (approx. C$1.1M) in the open market and received matching RSUs vesting over three years. This is a routine meeting outcome and an insider investment, not a transformative special situation. No deal, tender, activism, or restructuring is present.
